summary: StickyPOS is not a POS or loyalty software company but a manufacturer of self-cleaning, linerless thermal labels for POS/kitchen printers used to tag drive-thru and to-go bags for order accuracy; the company reports having sold more than eight billion labels, a 99.99% quality rating, and serving more than 23,000 stores daily, with customers seeing roughly a 5% increase in order accuracy from using its labels. (Scope note: Despite the 'POS' in its name, StickyPOS is a consumable-labeling hardware/supplies vendor, not a competing point-of-sale software platform.)
